# Miyoo Mini Toolchain

OpenAL is built with the Miyoo Mini Buildroot SDK. Download and verify it with:

```sh
scripts/fetch-toolchain.sh
```

The build uses:

- `shauninman/miyoomini-toolchain-buildroot-aarch64` v0.0.3
- SHA-256: `ad35e1e19e4741c08efe878909e3cd65b39b736c447b2b089cd9fe74d7bc8f5c`

The archive and extracted SDK stay under the ignored `artifacts` directory.
They are not part of this repository or its releases.
